name: Abjuration
desc: Abjuration spells are protective in nature, though some of them have aggressive uses. They create magical barriers, negate harmful effects, harm trespassers, or banish creatures to other planes of existence.
content: Abjuration (index: abjuration) spells are protective and can also be used aggressively. They create magical barriers, negate harmful effects, harm trespassers, or banish creatures to other planes of existence. This school of magic focuses on defense and warding off threats, making it essential for protecting oneself or others in various situations.

name: Conjuration
desc: Conjuration spells involve the transportation of objects and creatures from one location to another. Some spells summon creatures or objects to the caster's side, whereas others allow the caster to teleport to another location. Some conjurations create objects or effects out of nothing.
content: Conjuration (conj) spells involve the transportation of objects and creatures from one location to another, allowing summoning, teleportation, and creation of objects or effects out of nothing. This magic school specializes in manipulating space and matter, requiring a deep understanding of the intricacies of spatial dimensions and the ability to channel magical energy efficiently. Players skilled in Conjuration can master powerful spells that bend reality to their will, making them formidable allies or foes on the battlefield.

name: Divination
desc: Divination spells reveal information, whether in the form of secrets long forgotten, glimpses of the future, the locations of hidden things, the truth behind illusions, or visions of distant people or places.
content: Divination is a school of magic that specializes in revealing information through spells. These spells can unveil secrets long forgotten, offer glimpses of the future, locate hidden things, uncover the truth behind illusions, and provide visions of distant people or places. It is a powerful magic school that taps into the unknown, making it essential for those seeking knowledge and insight.

name: Evocation
desc: Evocation spells manipulate magical energy to produce a desired effect. Some call up blasts of fire or lightning. Others channel positive energy to heal wounds.
content: Evocation (index: evocation) spells harness magical energy to create desired effects, such as fire or lightning blasts, or healing wounds with positive energy. This school of magic focuses on manipulating mystical forces for specific outcomes. Explore more about Evocation at /api/magic-schools/evocation.

name: Illusion
desc: Illusion spells deceive the senses or minds of others. They cause people to see things that are not there, to miss things that are there, to hear phantom noises, or to remember things that never happened. Some illusions create phantom images that any creature can see, but the most insidious illusions plant an image directly in the mind of a creature.
content: Illusion spells in the magic school of Illusion deceive the senses or minds of others by creating phantom images or planting images directly in the mind of a creature. These spells cause people to see things that are not there, miss things that are there, hear phantom noises, or remember things that never happened. Illusion magic is all about creating convincing false perceptions and manipulating the mind to create illusions that can trick even the most discerning individuals.

name: Enchantment
desc: Enchantment spells affect the minds of others, influencing or controlling their behavior. Such spells can make enemies see the caster as a friend, force creatures to take a course of action, or even control another creature like a puppet.
content: The Enchantment spell school specializes in influencing or controlling the minds of others, allowing casters to manipulate their behavior and perceptions. Enchantment spells can be used to make enemies view the caster as a friend, compel creatures to follow specific actions, or even puppeteer another being. This school of magic is aligned with skills related to charm, persuasion, and manipulation, making it a powerful tool for social interaction and combat strategy.

name: Necromancy
desc: Necromancy spells manipulate the energies of life and death. Such spells can grant an extra reserve of life force, drain the life energy from another creature, create the undead, or even bring the dead back to life.
content: Necromancy (index: necromancy) is a magical school that focuses on manipulating the energies of life and death. Necromancy spells can grant additional life force, drain life energy from creatures, create undead beings, and even resurrect the dead. This dark and powerful magic is associated with skills in life force manipulation and understanding the balance between life and death.

name: Transmutation
desc: Transmutation spells change the properties of a creature, object, or environment. They might turn an enemy into a harmless creature, bolster the strength of an ally, make an object move at the caster's command, or enhance a creature's innate healing abilities to rapidly recover from injury.
content: The Transmutation (Transmutation) school of magic focuses on spells that alter the properties of creatures, objects, or environments. These spells can transform enemies into harmless beings, strengthen allies, control objects remotely, or enhance healing abilities for rapid recovery from injuries. Transmutation is a versatile school that requires a deep understanding of magic and the ability to manipulate the fundamental nature of things.
